title: Init — Brownfield project (audit + gap-fill)
description: One session: discover → architecture retrofit → convention alignment → environment verify → pipeline gap-fill → documentation gap-fill. Each segment is one approve; phases disabled in devkit.workflow-profile.json init.enabled_phases are skipped (discover always runs).

steps.title: Discover existing repository
steps.notes: Brownfield step 1 of 6 — ALWAYS runs (not affected by init.enabled_phases). Read manifests, README, Docker, CI, docs; record evidence in .vibe/research/brownfield-init.md. No proposals here — downstream steps cite this file.

steps.title: Backfill ADRs for existing architecture
steps.notes: Brownfield step 2 of 6 — retrofit ADRs for decisions already in code (data store, API style, runtime, auth, app architecture). Index file + one ADR per decision under docs/adrs/. Candidates are filtered to the project stack (devkit.config.json `stack`); pick those matching the repo. Skipped when phase architecture is disabled.

skill_candidates.label: Database design
skill_candidates.when: Schema, migrations, ORM, indexing — retrofit DB decisions when repo evidence points to Postgres/Mongo/etc.

skill_candidates.label: REST API
skill_candidates.when: Code uses REST-style HTTP endpoints — backfill ADR around routing/versioning.

skill_candidates.label: GraphQL API
skill_candidates.when: Code exposes a GraphQL schema — backfill ADR around schema/resolvers.

skill_candidates.label: tRPC
skill_candidates.when: Repo uses tRPC end-to-end typesafe RPC.

steps.title: Audit & gap-fill project conventions
steps.notes: Brownfield step 3 of 6 — audit lint/format/hooks/tests. Add only what is missing; never swap an adopted tool. Candidate `dev.tdd` when test harness is absent. Skipped when phase scaffold is disabled.

skill_candidates.label: Apply lint / format / hooks
skill_candidates.when: Gap-fill lint, Prettier, Husky, EditorConfig using existing deps.

skill_candidates.label: Introduce a test harness
skill_candidates.when: No test runner is present yet — start with small red/green slices on foundation code.

steps.title: Verify & patch local environment
steps.notes: Brownfield step 4 of 6 — audit docker/compose/env templates. Add missing services, pin versions, generate .env.example from discovered env vars. Skipped when phase environment is disabled.

steps.title: Audit CI/CD & add missing gates
steps.notes: Brownfield step 5 of 6 — audit existing pipelines. Priority: test → lint → image-pin → security scan. Never silently weaken a gate. Skipped when phase pipeline is disabled.

steps.title: Audit docs & close onboarding gaps
steps.notes: Brownfield step 6 of 6 — audit README / CONTRIBUTING / docs/specs / docs/adrs. Metric: first-green-test time for a new engineer. Gap-fill only; do not rewrite working prose. Skipped when phase documentation is disabled.

skill_candidates.label: Deeper docs quality pass
skill_candidates.when: Onboarding gap is narrative/tone, not just missing files.
